concerns.text: FR-001 requires retrieving Materials Project entries with both magnetic_moment and curie_temperature via the public REST API, but the Materials Project API mandates a private API key. On the CI runner (free‑tier GitHub Actions) no key is available, making the required data inaccessible and preventing any model training or evaluation for Curie temperature. This violates the functional requirement and renders the core research question (predicting both saturation magnetization *and* Curie temperature) unsolvable as specified.
